mapper.select:
SELECT p.*, m.nick_name AS member_nickname, m.avatar_url AS member_avatar FROM mall_market_post p LEFT JOIN mall_member m ON m.member_id = p.member_id WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.status != '2' AND p.moderated = 0 AND p.review_status = '1' AND m.status != '1'
AND p.category = #{category}
AND (p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mall_market_post (member_id, title, description, price, price_type, images, category, status, phone, whatsapp, messenger, telegram, viber, wechat, line, instagram, location_label, latitude, longitude, view_count, comment_count, del_flag, create_time) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{price}, COALESCE(#{priceType}, 'fixed'), #{images}, #{category}, '0', #{phone}, #{whatsapp}, #{messenger}, #{telegram}, #{viber}, #{wechat}, #{line}, #{instagram}, #{locationLabel}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, 0, 0, '0', NOW())

mapper.select: SELECT r.*, m.nick_name AS reporter_nickname, CASE r.target_type WHEN 'post' THEN (SELECT title FROM mall_market_post WHERE post_id = r.target_id) WHEN 'comment' THEN (SELECT content FROM mall_market_comment WHERE comment_id = r.target_id) END AS target_title FROM mall_market_report r LEFT JOIN mall_member m ON m.member_id = r.reporter_id ORDER BY r.status ASC, r.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE mall_market_report SET status = #{status}, handled_by = #{handledBy}, handled_note = #{handledNote}, handle_time = NOW() WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
